verdict.rationale: Rootly's AI Summaries generate titles, summaries, catchups and status write-ups during the incident, explicitly "so nobody has to write documentation mid-incident." They are available via `/rootly summary` and as private catch-ups for responders who join midstream. Meeting Scribe joins the bridge automatically and keeps a live, speaker-labeled transcript attached to the incident, which also feeds the drafted retrospective sections. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that live summaries, drafted updates and scribe notes work well in practice.
